pages.text: $(l)Tinkers' Construct$() is about building your own tools. You cast and assemble them from separate parts, each of a different material, then keep modifying them instead of crafting a replacement.$(br2)Its $(l)Smeltery$() melts and alloys metals, and that is the part MC3DPrint has to care about: a Smeltery alloy is not a crafting recipe, so its value cannot be derived.

The $(l)Smeltery$() is not a crafting recipe, so its alloys are priced by hand, along with cobalt because that is $(l)mined$(). They run $(l)Tier 3$() to $(l)Tier 6$().$(br2)Manyullyn sits at the top because it alloys cobalt with netherite scrap: any lower and down-only printing would launder diamond-tier filament into a debris metal.
pages.title: Values

pages.text: $(l)Necrotic bone$() is $(l)wind-only$(): a wither skeleton farm makes them in bulk, so it recycles into filament and is never printable.$(br2)That is the standing shape of the rule. Anything a farm can produce faster than it should be worth is a sink rather than a product, whichever mod adds it.
pages.title: A Filament Sink
